name: agent-orch
description: Stage-first orchestration with environment audits, user-selected model routes, concise worker events, reviewed parallel integration, recoverable Git commits, and safe worktree retirement.

interface.shortDescription: Audit environments, commit tasks, and retire worktrees.
interface.longDescription: Select stage models and Worker reasoning/service tier. Audit inherited Git changes without guessing ownership, approve concrete reconciliation, and supervise isolated CC, AGY, or Codex workers with concise events. Independently review and accept implementations, integrate parallel results with fresh review, then verify, commit exact task changes and safely retire worktrees. Preserve unrelated edits and durable recovery evidence. Hooks do not wake idle chats.
defaultPrompt: Initialize model routes and Git policies, audit existing changes and worktrees, and present concrete reconciliation choices.
Implement and independently review this task, then finalize its exact local commit and safely retire its worktree while preserving unrelated edits.
Integrate accepted parallel task results, independently review and accept the combined patch, then commit and clean up.
